title: Shadows over the Sword Coast

world.name: Forgotten Realms
world.overview: Set in the iconic city of Baldur's Gate and surrounding areas, this campaign follows the economic and magical crisis spurred by the iron shortage. Players are thrust into a web of conspiracies and divine legacy.

summary: The story begins in the ancient fortress-library of Candlekeep. Hidden behind massive walls and guarded knowledge, your days are filled with study, duty, and strange silences. But something stirs in the shadows of these tomes—a destiny written long before your time.
recap: You’ve spent the last few days wandering Candlekeep’s stone courtyards and candlelit halls. Whispers follow your steps. Your foster father, Gorion, has grown distant and uneasy. Something is coming. Something dark.

locations.name: Candlekeep
locations.description: A secluded fortress-library where the players begin, raised by Gorion.

locations.name: Friendly Arm Inn
locations.description: A fortified roadside inn serving as a safe meeting point.

locations.name: Beregost
locations.description: A trade town with inns, merchants, and early signs of the Iron Throne's influence.

locations.name: Nashkel
locations.description: Mining town affected by the iron crisis and haunted by ancient forces.

locations.name: Cloakwood Forest
locations.description: A dangerous forest housing secrets and a hidden base tied to the Iron Throne.

locations.name: Baldur's Gate
locations.description: A sprawling city filled with intrigue, divided into Upper, Lower, and Outer districts.

factions.Iron Throne: Merchant consortium manipulating the iron crisis.
factions.Flaming Fist: Mercenary force maintaining order in Baldur's Gate.
factions.Cult of Bhaal: Dark cult tied to divine heritage and murder.

npcs.Gorion: The players’ mentor, assassinated early in the story.

storyline.summary: Players flee Candlekeep after Gorion’s death.
Investigate the iron crisis through Beregost and Nashkel.
Explore Cloakwood, uncover Iron Throne’s secrets and Bhaal cult links.
Enter Baldur’s Gate amidst political chaos and corruption.
Unveil Sarevok’s plans and face him in a final battle.

map_plan: Dungeon maps (Nashkel Mines, Cloakwood Base, Sarevok’s Lair)
